text:
Nina Cho: proposal: add a "Preview logs" quick action on route config that returns one sampled req/res for debugging without enabling inspect. big PII risk.
Eli Romero: sounds useful. must be sampled + redacted. show redaction_reason and confidence (HIGH/MED/LOW).
Priya Singh: also add per-tenant preview_budget to prevent abuse. preview should consume from that budget and be throttled. UI shows budget remaining.
Carmen (ops): we need a breakglass path for oncall but single-use tokens only, logged to audit and devops-runbook.
Eli Romero: API header idea: `X-Preview-Mode: level` + `X-Preview-Id`. sampler rule checks header, consults tenant.preview_budget, returns masked sample or 403. fallback: "preview unavailable" UI.
Priya Singh: routing hint: background_preview -> prefer cached/quantized models to avoid load. also never include embeddings in preview.
Nina Cho: UX: add small shield icon + hover explaining redaction reason. offer "request audit" that files a ticket rather than auto-unredact.
AuditBot: created ticket INF-8820 for "preview_quota + breakglass doc"
Nina Cho: action items: Eli proto header + sampler change, Priya budget + routing hints, Carmen write runbook note. check-in Fri 11am.
